title: flow designer: Remove node leaves its edges behind, and the reused node id re-attaches them — a published flow ran one create_record three times for one update
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: a published flow authored entirely in Studio ran one `create_record` node three times for one record update (measured through the public data API).

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio / app-shell owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

Removing a node in the Studio flow designer leaves the edges that pointed at it in the document. The next node added gets the same id (`node_1`), so the stale edges silently re-attach to it. In the published flow below, `edges` held `start→node_1` three times; one status change created **three identical follow-up records**. The canvas draws the three edges on top of each other, so the author sees one line, and the Problems panel says "No problems — this flow is structurally valid." The Runs panel shows the same run executing `node_1 CREATE_RECORD` three times and never reaching `end`.

## Reproduction

1. Studio → a writable package → Automations → New ("Notify on Ticket Done").
2. Start node: Trigger *Record updated*, Object `repairs_repair_ticket`, Entry condition `status == 'done' && previous.status != 'done'`.
3. Click the edge's "+" (*Insert node here*) → a `create_record` node appears → inspector *Remove node*.
4. Select Start → *Add connected node* → configure the new `create_record` (object `repairs_repair_ticket`, field `name` = `Follow-up created by flow`).
5. Publish all. `PATCH /api/v1/data/repairs_repair_ticket/{id}` with `{"status":"done","due_date":"2026-10-20"}`.
6. `GET /api/v1/data/repairs_repair_ticket` → three `Follow-up created by flow` rows. `GET /api/v1/meta/flow/<name>` → edges `e1 start→node_1`, `edge_1 start→node_1`, `edge_3 start→node_1`, `edge_2 node_1→end`.

Second, independent reproduction (flow `repro_edges`): after step 3 the saved draft holds nodes `[start, end]` but edges `[start→node_1, node_1→end]` — dangling, and the original `start→end` is gone.

## Expected

Removing a node removes its incoming and outgoing edges (and reconnects predecessor → successor when it sat on a single path). A fresh node never inherits edges left by a removed one.

## Where it comes from (read in source)

- `FlowNodeInspector`'s `remove` callback (`app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/FlowNodeInspector.tsx`) writes `null` to the node's location and clears the selection; nothing touches `edges`.
- New ids come from `uniqueId('node', existing)` over the *current* node ids only, so a removed id is reused.
- The server half is objectstack-ai/objectstack#22088 (it publishes such a flow with `_diagnostics.valid: true`).

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Drop every edge whose `source` or `target` is the removed node in the same patch, reconnecting single-path predecessors to successors; never reuse an id that existed in this editing session; have the Problems panel flag edges whose endpoint is not a node and repeated (source, target) pairs.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *flow designer remove node dangling edges duplicate edges node executed multiple times*: 2 hits (0 open, 2 closed).
- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectstack (open and closed), *flow engine executes target node once per incoming edge duplicate execution create_record*: 3 hits (0 open, 3 closed).
- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *flow canvas delete node leaves orphan edges reconnect*: 0 hits (0 open, 0 closed).
- Related, not the same defect:
  - objectstack-ai/objectstack#14964 (closed) — same malformed-edges family on the spec side (duplicate edge ids), not node removal / dangling endpoints
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#10948 (closed) — neighbouring flow-designer save-integrity card; different defect
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.
